about: Carve's plans, in one place (club sprint item 5). scripts/pricing/build_plans.py writes, from this, the pricing page's organizer card, plan lines and Individual's prices, and web/assets/plans.js?v=a1e99a533b; the server's plan_limits holds the same organizers (a test checks they match); Stripe's prices are set by the lookup keys carve_<plan>_<interval> (docs/Stripe-Setup.md on club-stripe). Three plans (Chris, 11/10 afternoon: one plan for organizers): for drivers, Free and Individual (the store Apex); for organizers, Club, $499 a year, with multi-day drives, pre-drives, smart planning for every organizer and 5 organizers, and no driver cap shown. Club starts with a 30-day free trial in Stripe, card at checkout, charged on day 31 unless cancelled. Group is gone: an org still on the old 'group' tier reads as Club (oldTiers). Custom quotes (more than 5 organizers, invoicing, event help) are by contact. drivers: 0, no club drives; null, no driver cap shown.
